faq.q: How much do photos and videos cost?
faq.a: Starter costs $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro costs $35 for 300, and Premium costs $63 for 600. Photos cost 24 credits; videos cost 24 to 120 credits, depending on length.

faq.q: Can I make a video from my product page?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a public product link to start a video with its photos and details. Check that the result matches what you sell before posting.
Use a sharp photo where the whole product is visible and the color is easy to judge. You can add up to 7 reference photos when the job asks for them.

faq.q: Can I make a UGC-style video without filming?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI actor, add your product photo or link, and make a creator-style video in a few minutes. You do not need a camera or creator.

faq.q: Can I use my own face or make ads in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Use your own face and voice with permission, or choose from 53 AI actors. You can make another version in the language your customers speak.

faq.q: Will a watermark sit on the file I post?
faq.a: No. Downloaded images and videos do not include an AIVideosUGC watermark. You can use the file in a paid ad.

faq.q: Can I run these images and videos as my own ads?
faq.a: Yes. You can publish downloaded images and videos on your product pages, in your ads, and in social posts. Follow the rules of the place you post them.

faq.q: Which video lengths and sizes can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds and sizes including 9:16, 1:1, and 16:9. You can also choose 4:3 or 3:4.

faq.q: What can I make from a photo or product link?
faq.a: You can make product videos, creator-style ads, and product photos from a photo or link. Add an AI actor, voice, and captions to videos without filming.

faq.q: Can I change a video before posting it?
faq.a: Yes. Change the words, voice, actor, music, or captions, then make a new version. You can test several versions without filming again.

faq.q: Do I need a paid plan to make my first photo or video?
faq.a: Yes. Starter costs $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro costs $35 for 300, and Premium costs $63 for 600. Failed jobs return their credits.

faq.q: When can I download my finished file?
faq.a: You can download your photo or video after it is generated, usually in a few minutes. If generation fails, your credits return.

faq.q: Can another shop see my uploads or my finished files?
faq.a: No. Other customers cannot see your uploads or your generated files. They stay in your account and are not posted for you.

faq.q: Where can I post these videos and photos?
faq.a: Use them as paid ads, as clips on a product page, and as social posts. Start with one clear product image and pick the frame the channel wants.
